judgement.reason: DbGate is a single web app that can be configured by environment, so a contained repository change is a reasonable outcome.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: docker-compose.yaml defines 2 application services (dbgate, proxy). Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: The compose file is marked as a local testing stack and the production Dockerfile starts only the single dbgate web process, so the nginx proxy service is not part of production.

evidence.quote: # this compose file is for testing purposes only

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /root/.dbgate (docker/Dockerfile), volume dbgate-data:/root/.dbgate (docker-compose.yaml dbgate)
reviews.reason: The production Dockerfile declares VOLUME /root/.dbgate, and no shown setting moves the data stored there (connections, settings) to a managed datastore.
